description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the land in Attapitiya Village, Aranayaka D/S Division, Kegalle District for Drinking Water Supply Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with the acquisition of immovable property (land) for the construction of a water purification unit and storage tank. It contains a detailed legal description of the land parcel, including its location, boundaries, and extent. While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) and his ministry, the core subject matter is land acquisition for a specific public works project, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
